stemMd: Which EU body brings together national ministers to negotiate and adopt legislation with Parliament?

options.label: C
options.textMd: The Council of the European Union

explanationMd: The Council of the EU represents member-state governments through ministers. Its composition varies with the subject under discussion. It must be distinguished from the European Council and the Council of Europe.

distractorRationale.e: This is a separate international organisation.
distractorRationale.d: It gathers leaders and defines political direction.
distractorRationale.a: It is not the ministers' legislative council.
